deficiencies: Gate G1.3 (npx tsc --noEmit, expect /^/) fails with regex-timeout on the installed rivr 0.15.0. Reproduced with a throwaway probe ledger: check=echo hello, expect=/^/ fails identically while a literal oracle passes. The tsc check itself passes in 3.1s with exit 0 and empty output. The /^/ oracle cannot be satisfied by the installed runner, so the gate can never record a pass. Fix in research: re-define G1.3 with a literal success marker, for example check=npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK, expect=TSC_OK.

findings.deficiency: Gate G1.3 (npx tsc --noEmit, expect /^/) fails with regex-timeout on the installed rivr 0.15.0. Reproduced with a throwaway probe ledger: check=echo hello, expect=/^/ fails identically while a literal oracle passes. The tsc check itself passes in 3.1s with exit 0 and empty output. Fix in research: re-define G1.3 with a literal success marker, for example check=npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK, expect=TSC_OK.
